욥기 17:1.content: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.

욥기 17:2.content: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

욥기 17:3.content: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?

욥기 17:4.content: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.

욥기 17:5.content: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

욥기 17:6.content: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

욥기 17:7.content: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

욥기 17:8.content: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

욥기 17:9.content: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

욥기 17:10.content: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

욥기 17:11.content: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

욥기 17:12.content: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

욥기 17:13.content: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

욥기 17:14.content: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.

욥기 17:15.content: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

욥기 17:16.content: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
